chinese: 今天我想讨论社交媒体对心理健康的影响
english: Today I want to discuss the impact of social media on mental health
soundmark: /təˈdeɪ aɪ wɒnt tuː dɪˈskʌs ðə ˈɪmpækt ɒv ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ɒn ˈmentəl helθ/

chinese: 社交媒体确实帮助我们与他人保持联系
english: It's true that social media helps us stay connected with others
soundmark: /ɪts truː ðæt ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə helps ʌs steɪ kəˈnektɪd wɪð ˈʌðərz/

chinese: 但花太多时间在网上会导致焦虑和不满
english: But spending too much time online can lead to feelings of anxiety and dissatisfaction
soundmark: /bʌt ˈspendɪŋ tuː mʌtʃ taɪm ˈɒnlaɪn kæn liːd tuː ˈfiːlɪŋz ɒv æŋˈzaɪəti ænd dɪˌsætɪsˈfækʃən/

chinese: 一个原因是我们经常将自己的真实生活与他人完美的网络形象进行比较
english: One reason is that we often compare our real lives to others' perfect online images
soundmark: /wʌn ˈriːzən ɪz ðæt wiː ˈɒfən kəmˈpeər ˈaʊər rɪəl laɪvz tuː ˈʌðərz ˈpɜːrfɪkt ˈɒnlaɪn ˈɪmɪdʒɪz/

chinese: 解决方法不是完全退出而是更有意识地使用社交媒体
english: The solution is not to quit completely but to use social media more mindfully
soundmark: /ðə səˈluːʃən ɪz nɒt tuː kwɪt kəmˈpliːtli bʌt tuː juːz ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə mɔːr ˈmaɪndfəli/

chinese: 限制你的屏幕使用时间多关注现实世界的互动
english: Set limits on your screen time and focus on real world interactions
soundmark: /set ˈlɪmɪts ɒn jɔːr skriːn taɪm ænd ˈfoʊkəs ɒn rɪəl wɜːrld ˌɪntərˈækʃənz/
